sources.reading_verification: Downloaded the complete article from SciELO in HTML and converted it to text. Read the abstract and Sections 1-3: the cusp models Q_{k,alpha} of power sharpness alpha>1; the weighted Sobolev space in which the trace estimate is formulated; the statement that the trace operator exists and is compact when the sharpness is below a critical exponent; Condition A1, Theorem 4 and Corollary 5 on the weighted trace estimate; Condition A2 and Theorem 8 for almost-Lipschitz domains; and the references to Acosta-Armentano-Duran-Lombardi and to Maz'ya-Netrusov-Poborchi. contents.support: The companion page's explicit concentrating sequence proves the failure of the plain estimate for a standard outward cusp with alpha>p.
